info.title: v2.logistics.update_tracking_status
info.description: Only available for Brazil sellers. This API is only available for orders/parcels which are fulfilled by BR Seller Logistics channel (logistics_channel_id: 90021), Samsung (logistics_channel_id: 90025) and BR Instant Delivery channel (logistics_channel_id: 90026). The logistics_status will become LOGISTICS_REQUEST_CREATED after arrange shipment, and can call this API to update to: LOGISTICS_PICKUP_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_FAILED.

post.description: Only available for Brazil sellers. This API is only available for orders/parcels which are fulfilled by BR Seller Logistics channel (logistics_channel_id: 90021), Samsung (logistics_channel_id: 90025) and BR Instant Delivery channel (logistics_channel_id: 90026). The logistics_status will become LOGISTICS_REQUEST_CREATED after arrange shipment, and can call this API to update to: LOGISTICS_PICKUP_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_DONE, LOGISTICS_DELIVERY_FAILED.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: failed_reason
parameters.description: Only required when updating logistics_status to "logistics_delivery_failed". Only required for BR Instant Delivery channel (logistics_channel_id: 90026). Only accept the following values. - buyer_unreachable - buyer_unresponsive - no_delivery_location_consensus

parameters.name: logistics_status
parameters.description: Order status update support: - logistics_pickup_done - logistics_delivery_done - logistics_delivery_failed

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: tracking_number
parameters.description: Order tracking number, might help seller to identify his order on the tracking_URL. Can only be sent when updating logistics_status to "logistic_pickup_done".

parameters.name: tracking_url
parameters.description: Website's URL for order tracking with maximum length of 2048 characters. Can only be sent when updating logistics_status to "logistic_pickup_done".

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
